error[ZBX-E0528]: AWS refused the credentials
  cause  AWS refused the environment's keys: ExpiredTokenException
  status 400
  aws    ExpiredTokenException
  fix    check that the keys are current: temporary keys expire
         get new credentials, then run the command again
  more   zbx explain E0528
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0528.html
